init_hook: echo '🚀 Devbox shell に入りました'
echo '📖 セットアップ手順は docs/1_setup_devbox.md を参照'
echo '📖 サーバー起動手順は docs/2_setup.md を参照'
echo '📖 よく使うコマンドは docs/commands.md を参照'

setup: echo '【TODO】依存インストールコマンドをここに記載 (例: pnpm install)'
dev: echo '【TODO】開発サーバー起動コマンドをここに記載'
test: echo '=== [1/6] イメージをビルドしてkindに読み込み ==='
docker build -t target-server ./target && docker build -t attacker ./attacker && docker build -t api -f api/Dockerfile .
kind load docker-image target-server && kind load docker-image attacker && kind load docker-image api
echo '=== [2/6] monitoring namespace & Pod を起動 ===' && kubectl apply -f manifests/monitoring/namespace.yaml && kubectl apply -f manifests/monitoring/
echo '=== [3/6] game Pod を起動 ===' && kubectl apply -f manifests/game/
echo '--- Pod 起動待機 ---' && kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l io.kompose.service=target-server --timeout=60s && kubectl wait --for=condition=ready pod -l io.kompose.service=api --timeout=60s
echo '=== [4/6] attacker x3 にスケール ===' && kubectl scale deployment attacker --replicas=3 && sleep 3

echo '=== [5/6] api 経由で 5 回攻撃 & WebSocket疎通確認 ===' && { kubectl port-forward svc/api 9000:9000 & PF_PID=$!; kubectl port-forward svc/target-server 8080:8080 & PF_WS_PID=$!; trap 'kill $PF_PID $PF_WS_PID 2>/dev/null' EXIT; sleep 2; curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:9000/attack -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"target":"all","count":5}' && echo; sleep 2; (curl -sf --max-time 3 -i -N -H 'Upgrade: websocket' -H 'Connection: Upgrade' -H 'Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==' -H 'Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13' http://localhost:8080/ws 2>&1 | grep -q '101' && echo 'WebSocket: OK') || echo 'WebSocket: FAILED'; }
echo '=== [6/6] 攻撃後ログ ===' && kubectl logs -l io.kompose.service=target-server --tail=20 && kubectl logs -l io.kompose.service=attacker --tail=20
kubectl delete -f manifests/game/ && kubectl delete -f manifests/monitoring/ && echo '=== テスト完了 ==='
